disclosures: Each isolated impact forces exactly one event to occur, disables every unrelated event, and compares paired runs with identical schedule, seed, trials, and model parameters.
Raw team-strength delta is a model input, not standings points; outcome deltas come only from the paired simulation.
The forced ceiling includes positive-strength events only. The naturally sampled run retains original marginal probabilities and explicit correlation keys.
Display path labels round only the summed strength input; raw sums remain authoritative.
